Controller

Technical details
Can’t connect?
  • Power the strip on and bring the phone close.
  • Close other apps that hold the strip (Magic Lantern, LED LAMP). It talks to one app at a time.
  • Turn Bluetooth on and allow Nearby devices for MELK Studio in Android settings.

Vehicle & Drive

Vehicle profile

Driving and Parked

You choose the mode in Car mode; driving is not detected. Driving shows only calm scenes, caps brightness and blocks flashing, fast and hardware effects.

Scenes

Recent

Custom app scenes

Saved app configurations such as Relax and Movie are preserved here. ★ adds a custom scene to Car mode; native hardware Movie is in Effects → Scenes.

Auto / Custom Rotation

Native hardware scenes only. Rotation needs MELK Studio in the foreground, a connection and Parked mode. When stopped, the last scene remains on the controller. This is separate from Magic Lantern Auto Play (mode 0).

Stopped. Choose native scenes, then Start.

Automation & timers

Original Auto behaviour

Auto (in the scene row) picks scenes by time of day, or rotates built-in patterns. Rotating needs the app open and connected.

Daily routines

Uses your phone’s time. Runs only while the app is open and the strip is connected.

Experimental Lab

Hardware tests

Park the car and keep the app open. These tests send known Magic Lantern effect numbers to the strip. Nothing changes your scenes unless you press Add.

Hardware Rainbow test

UNVERIFIED

0 of 4 candidates tested

Run a candidate, watch the strip, close the app, then record what you saw.

How to test
  1. Run a candidate and watch the strip.
  2. Does it move along the strip like Magic Lantern’s rainbow? Record Yes or No.
  3. Swipe MELK Studio away and wait two minutes. Is it still moving? Reopen and record it.
  4. Power the strip off and on. Does it come back? Record it.

The phone Rainbow under My effects always freezes when the app closes. That is expected and makes a good control.
